articles.title: BCP Investment Corporation Schedules Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call
articles.mainIdea: BCP Investment Corporation Schedules Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: BCP Investment Corporation Schedules Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call. Call Scheduled for 10:00 am ET on Friday, March 6, 2026NEW YORK, Jan. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BCP Investment Corporation (NASDAQ: BCIC) (“BCIC” or “the Company”) is to release its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025, on Thursday, March 5, 2026, after market close. The Company will host a conference call on Friday, March 6, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss these results. By Phone: To access the call, please dial (646) 307-1963 approximately 10 minu Related tickers mentioned: BCIC.

articles.title: Miller Launches ArcCapture™ Weld Camera Systems
articles.mainIdea: Miller Launches ArcCapture™ Weld Camera Systems
articles.summary: Business Wire: Miller Launches ArcCapture™ Weld Camera Systems. APPLETON, Wis. APPLETON, Wis., January 12, 2026--Miller Electric Mfg. LLC, a leading manufacturer of arc welding equipment, has announced the release of its ArcCapture weld camera systems, designed to enhance training, instruction and efficiency in both educational and automated welding environments.
